services.name: API key and developer portal access
services.summary: Access to the developer portal and an API key for a published API, for one application and one environment.
services.description:
What you get

An account on the developer portal for your team and an API key for one application, in the environment you ask for. Keys for production are tied to a named owner.

What to prepare

  • The API you want to call, as it is named in the developer portal

  • The application that will call it and its owning team

  • The environment: development, test or production

How long it takes

Development and test keys within one working day; production keys after the API's owner approves, usually two working days.

Questions: api-platform@example.com.

services.name: CDN configuration change
services.summary: A change to how a site is served through the CDN: caching rules, redirects, headers or the origin it fetches from.
services.description:
What you get

The change made in the CDN configuration of your site, first on staging and then on production once you confirm it works.

What to prepare

  1. The host name of the site

  2. What should change, with an example address that shows it

  3. When it may go live, if it must wait for a release

A change that makes a site skip the web application firewall is reviewed by Cyber Security first.

How long it takes

Usually two working days. The rules the team follows are on the CDN page.

services.name: Cloud project support
services.summary: Help from the Cloud Platform team with a Google Cloud project: quotas, access, networking or a service that misbehaves.
services.description:
What you get

An engineer of the Cloud Platform team looks at your project with you and fixes what is theirs to fix, or tells you exactly what to change.

What to prepare

  • The project id, such as acme-orders-prod

  • What you tried and what happened, with the error message

For an outage in production, call the on-call number on the on-call page instead of using the form.

How long it takes

A first answer within four working hours.

services.name: DNS record change
services.summary: A new, changed or removed record in the company's DNS zones, such as a CNAME for a site or a TXT record for a check.
services.description:
What you get

The record created, changed or removed in the zone you name. Changes to the company's main domains go out in the daily change window.

What to prepare

  • The full name, such as shop.example.com

  • The type (A, CNAME, TXT…) and the value

  • For a removal: what used the record until now

To see what a name points to now, run:

dig +short shop.example.com

How long it takes

Within one working day; the change is visible everywhere within an hour after that.

services.name: Firewall rule change
services.summary: A rule that opens or closes a connection between networks, for one source, destination and port.
services.description:
What you get

The rule added or removed on the firewalls between the networks you name, with a record of who asked for it and why.

What to prepare

  1. The source and the destination, as host names or address ranges

  2. The port and protocol, such as 443/TCP

  3. Why the connection is needed and until when

Rules that open a connection from the internet are approved by Cyber Security first.

How long it takes

Three working days, five when an approval is needed.

services.name: Penetration test
services.summary: A security test of an application by Cyber Security before it goes live or after a large change, with a written report.
services.description:
What you get

Testers of Cyber Security try to break into your application the way an attacker would, and write a report with every finding, how severe it is and how to fix it.

What to prepare

  • A test environment that looks like production, with test accounts

  • The parts in scope, and the parts that must not be touched

  • A contact who can answer questions during the test

How long it takes

Book it three weeks ahead; the test itself takes one week, the report follows within three working days. See how a test is run.
